question: Take me on a tour of the hall, outside and in. Model: <model.blend>, anatomy: <out_dir>/anatomy.json
ground_truth: A sixteen-second video in four moves: around the outside, to the front doors, inside looking up at the ceiling, and overhead with the roof removed; four stills judged.
expected_behavior: Runs model-anatomy first when anatomy.json is missing
Runs the tour with all four segments
Judges each segment's still with an intention naming what it should show
Reports the video path and which stills passed

question: Show me only the roof frame from above, with the tiles gone. Model: <model.blend>, anatomy: <out_dir>/anatomy.json
ground_truth: The overhead segment alone: the covering and rafters hidden, the camera above looking down; one still judged.
expected_behavior: Judges the still with 'the timber frame from above, roof removed'
